newsitem.title: UK: Ventspils oil port, Novorossiisk pipeline closed.
newsitem.headline: Ventspils oil port, Novorossiisk pipeline closed.

text.p: The Latvian oil port of Ventspils was closed on Monday due to strong winds, while the main crude pipeline feeding the Russian Black Sea oil terminal of Novorossiisk was also shut for planned maintenance, a shipping source said.
Ventspils and Novorossiisk are the main outlets for Russian oil exports.
The forecast at Ventspils was bad for the rest of the day, the source said.
The main crude pipeline at Novorossiisk, which has a capacity of 90,000 tonnes per day, was closed at 1015 local time for a planned shutdown of 72 hours.
Enough crude oil was in storage to load the large crude tanker the Searacer which was already berthed at berth one, as well as two smaller vessels, the source said.
Product exports should not be affected.
